source.name: Kansas Geological Survey, oil and gas wells (ks_wells)

operator_label: Current operator of the matching lease (KGS)

at_risk.definition: KGS status 'Inactive Well', with a current operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked. USGS Kansas rows (from the Kansas Corporation Commission) carry no well IDs, so they are matched by location: the nearest KGS well within 300 m whose lease name shares a word with the USGS well name. That identifies the lease, not necessarily the exact well.
notes: CURR_OPERATOR is 'unavailable' for most old wells, treated as no operator. ORIG_OPERATOR (operator at drilling) is not used.
